patches.reason: The library guesses the word size from glibc's __WORDSIZE, else from __x86_64__, else assumes 32 bits (cmocka.h), and so redefines (u)intptr_t as a 32-bit type on aarch64. QNX 8.0's x86_64 and aarch64le targets are both LP64 and QNX's headers never define __WORDSIZE, so define it as 64.
